headline: Rashmi Saluja asks for extension in SAT case regarding SEBI UPSI ruling
hook: Saluja seeks more time in SEBI fight
summary: Former Religare chairperson Rashmi Saluja has sought more time in the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT) concerning a SEBI case involving Unpublished Price Sensitive Information and open-offer timing. The matter follows a May ruling that imposed disgorgement and penalties on her. The next hearing has been scheduled for October 9. The outcome could impact governance and leadership oversight at Religare Enterprises.
why_it_matters: Legal overhang on leadership continues for Religare

headline: Former Religare chair Rashmi Saluja requests extension in SAT case
hook: Religare leadership dispute heads to October hearing
summary: Former Religare Enterprises chairperson Rashmi Saluja has sought an extension regarding her ongoing matter at the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT). The tribunal has scheduled the next hearing for October 9. This legal development follows previous regulatory scrutiny involving the company's leadership and governance. Retail investors should note that ongoing litigation involving key management can influence corporate stability and stock sentiment.
why_it_matters: Leadership legal battles may impact corporate governance and stock volatility.
